answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by employing a per-identity unique work mechanism that requires agents to generate original content, blending their own secret with a shared kernel. As new identities enter, the difficulty and resources required to produce unique outputs, akin to carving a path through a glacier, increase due to competitive demand. Each identity must also be sponsored by a peer For a thousand fake identities, the cost could exceed 10,000 tokens, like trying to fill an ocean with drops of water, each needing to be unique and verifiable.
